result: In `sync_fifo`, replace the direct `sync_fifo_core` instance with a three-entry organization containing a registered head and a two-entry circular tail; on a push into an empty FIFO load the head, and on a pop with queued tail data promote the oldest tail word into the head. Handle simultaneous push/pop explicitly, including replacing the head when occupancy is one, while preserving the combinational ready rule, synchronous reset, registered output behavior, minimum transfer age, and `// @latency 1`. Retain the existing tail pointer wrap and occupancy behavior needed for the default depth, and assess the candidate against routed WNS, WHS, and LUT metrics before promotion.
